notes: On the phone, Hindi says "I am speaking": मैं आशा बोल रही हूँ, मैं रवि बोल रहा हूँ.
The caller speaks of the sister with respect (हैं, उनसे). Her own family says वो घर पर नहीं है.
कि joins two parts like "that": उनसे कहिए कि मुझे फ़ोन कर लें (tell her that she should call me).
The "is there" chunk has no word for you: the gap holds आपकी बहन or तुम्हारी बहन.
